paper.title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
paper.central_claim: AHE 通过组件/经验/决策三类可观测性（文件级可回滚组件、分层轨迹证据库、自声明预测的变更清单）闭环自动演化编码智能体 harness，十次迭代把 Terminal-Bench 2 从 69.7% 提到 77.0%，且冻结 harness 可迁移到 SWE-bench-verified 与其他基底，表明编码的是通用工程经验。

evidence.quote:
Prompt-only self-evolution misses the components that carry AHE’s gain.

The gaps to ACE and TF-GRPO trace to a layer mismatch. ACE distills natural-language playbooks the agent reads in-context, and TF-GRPO is a trajectory-feedback variant of GRPO that reinforces successful tool sequences; neither method opens the surrounding scaffolding to edits.
AHE instead jointly evolves system prompt, tools, middleware, and long-term memory, and §
4.4.1
shows the gain concentrates in the latter three components, exactly the layers ACE and TF-GRPO leave untouched.

evidence.quote:
Our evaluation drives evolution on Terminal-Bench 2 and probes transfer on SWE-bench-verified. Even though the frozen harness transfers to a second task surface and to three alternate base-model families, broader programming languages, repository-scale deployments, and human-in-the-loop workflows remain untested.

Evolution operating point.

AHE’s step budget and per-task timeout were fitted to GPT-5.4 high during evolution, so cross-model transfer numbers conflate harness portability with operating-point coupling—within one family the gain is non-monotone across reasoning tiers (§
4.3
). Untangling these factors will require re-running the loop under multiple operating points.

Self-modification governance.

AHE bounds edits to a workspace, attributes every change in a versioned manifest, and rolls back ineffective edits at file granularity, but it does not provide a complete guardrail stack. Long-horizon harness cleanup and stronger misuse prevention remain incomplete, and AHE should be viewed as a controlled research prototype rather than a fully mature autonomous self-improvement system.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认范围、operating-point coupling及self-modification治理限制。

The nearest neighbours ACE and TF-GRPO are run from the same seed. Not 4: other whole-harness or agent-archive evolution work is only named by category, and 'observability, not capability, is the bottleneck' is asserted rather than tested.

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. File-level components, layered evidence and a predictive manifest map one-to-one onto the three obstacles. The manifest's precision/recall and the single-component swaps give distinguishable predictions. Not 4: none of the three pillars is removed, so the central hypothesis is untested, and all roles share one model.

X.reason: Opus sides with sol. The workspace layout, read-only verifier/LLM config, manifest schema, attribution-before-distillation order, git commits, full prompts (App B) and k=2/T=10 (opus:O06) are specified. Not 4, because the retention step is not uniquely specified. (1) Algorithm 1 evaluates H_{t-1} but assigns H_best ← H_t (sol:E08, E09). (2) Rollback is described as automatic (opus:O07), but the Evolve prompt makes it a KEEP / IMPROVE / ROLLBACK judgement (opus:O08), and at iteration 7 the agent patched instead of rolling back (son55:E035). (3) The text says all roles run at high reasoning, while App A sets the Evolve agent to xhigh (sol:E12, E27).

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Official TB2 verifiers (Harbor) and SWE-bench-verified are used, and infrastructure failures count as failures. Not 4: verifier outputs also drive the loop, so 'mirror the evaluator' rules and TB2-adjacent memory can encode evaluator specifics.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Same-seed ACE/TF-GRPO comparisons and single-component swaps exist. The pillars are never ablated. Comparison protocols are unequal: AHE's figure is an in-loop best-of-10 at k=2 against k=3 single evaluations for the baselines (opus:O01–O03). External SOTA and leaderboard research enters only AHE's loop (opus:O09, son55:E013). Evolution budgets are not matched.

E.holdout.reason: Opus sides with son55. The headline is on the selection set: 89 TB2 tasks drive diagnosis and editing, the best of 10 in-loop iterations is chosen on the same tasks, and that in-loop score is reported (opus:O01, opus:O04, opus:O06). The manifest names TB2 tasks by identity. Cross-model transfer reuses those tasks. The only independent tasks (SWE-bench-verified, 500, frozen harness) show +0.4 pp success, with three repositories regressing, and 12% fewer tokens. A held-out test exists, hence above 1; its result is too small to carry the central claim, hence not 3.
